title: Parsley Health trust strip
description: A seafoam strip of five reassurances. On desktop they are 200×112 tiles with a 1px clover outline and 12px corners, each thin grey line icon sitting on and breaking the top border; on phones they become a list of rows with the icon at the left and clover hairlines between.
notes: icons come in as nodes (e.g. lucide icons) and are sized to 40px with a thin stroke
